name: Battleship Row
notes: The quays along the south-east side of Ford Island where the battle line lay moored on the morning of 7 December 1941. The position given is the F-6/F-7 moorings, where Arizona lay; it is anchored on the memorial that spans the wreck, because the row itself has no gazetteer entry.

sources.note: coordinates, via the memorial over the wreck at berth F-7
